defects_resolved.root_cause: Incorrect frontend data-path reference: read selectedRequest.shipping_company?.shipping_company_name instead of selectedRequest.vessel?.company_name.

results.objective: Verify Shipping Company can access Vessel Management page and view controls.
results.expected_result: Vessel Management page loads correctly with directory table and Register Vessel control.
results.actual_result: Vessel Management page loaded successfully in 5678 ms. Heading, table, and Register Vessel button are visible.
results.remarks: Fleet Vessel Management view rendered with full operational controls.

results.objective: Verify existing vessel records and required specification columns are displayed.
results.expected_result: Vessel records render correctly with specifications and operational details.
results.actual_result: Vessel table renders registered fleet vessels across columns (VESSEL NAME, IMO NUMBER, TYPE, FLAG, LENGTH, DRAFT).
results.remarks: Verified fleet vessels loaded for active shipping company.

results.objective: Verify vessel registration modal form loads with all required controls and fields.
results.expected_result: Registration form loads correctly and controls are accessible.
results.actual_result: Vessel registration form modal loaded in 892 ms. All maritime fields and controls are accessible.
results.remarks: Modal includes IMO, specifications, flag, type, and optional radio call sign.

results.objective: Verify required fields prevent submission of an empty vessel registration form.
results.expected_result: Submission is blocked and validation feedback appears.
results.actual_result: Empty form submission blocked in 770 ms. HTML5 valueMissing is True and modal remains open.
results.remarks: Required constraints protect database from incomplete maritime records.

results.objective: Verify invalid IMO numbers (wrong length / invalid pattern) are rejected.
results.expected_result: Invalid IMO is rejected with appropriate validation feedback.
results.actual_result: Invalid IMO number rejected in 2353 ms. HTML5 patternMismatch is True (\d{7} constraint enforced).
results.remarks: IMO 7-digit maritime standard strictly enforced on client input.

results.objective: Verify a valid unique 7-digit IMO number satisfies input pattern validation.
results.expected_result: Valid IMO is accepted without format errors.
results.actual_result: Valid 7-digit IMO '9826012' accepted in 913 ms without format errors.
results.remarks: Valid 7-digit IMO conforms to format specifications.

results.objective: Verify Call Sign field is optional as designed and allows empty submission.
results.expected_result: Vessel registration permits optional Call Sign.
results.actual_result: Call Sign field verified as optional in 89 ms. Element is not required and labeled 'Optional'.
results.remarks: Optional Call Sign accommodated per maritime standard for domestic vessels.

results.objective: Verify complete valid vessel registration successfully creates vessel record.
results.expected_result: New vessel is registered and displayed in company fleet list.
results.actual_result: Vessel 'Selenium Test Vessel 20261007161009' (IMO: 9826012, Call Sign: SELTEST01) registered successfully in 6192 ms and rendered in fleet table.
results.remarks: New vessel persisted in PostgreSQL and immediately rendered in UI.

results.objective: Verify duplicate IMO numbers cannot create duplicate vessels and are rejected.
results.expected_result: Duplicate IMO is rejected with appropriate validation/error feedback.
results.actual_result: Duplicate IMO rejected in 4332 ms. Error banner displayed: 'Vessel with this vessel imo number already exists.'.
results.remarks: Global uniqueness constraint on vessel IMO numbers successfully enforced.

results.objective: Verify user can view complete vessel technical specifications in details modal.
results.expected_result: Modal displays technical specs (dimensions, capacity, flag, type).
results.actual_result: Vessel specifications modal loaded in 1714 ms. Verified Name, IMO (9826012), LOA (220.0m), Draft (9.0m), and TEU capacity (2800).
results.root_cause: Locator `//div[contains(@class, 'fixed')]` matched the empty backdrop element instead of the dialog container. Fixed to resolve dialog from `modal_title` ancestor.
results.remarks: Dialog container ancestor selector resolved backdrop overlay interception.

results.objective: Verify vessel details can be edited while IMO remains locked and read-only.
results.expected_result: Vessel details update successfully; IMO field is locked.
results.actual_result: Vessel details updated in 2920 ms. Name updated to 'Selenium Test Vessel 20261007161009 (Edited)' while IMO was verified locked/read-only.
results.remarks: Read-only IMO attribute prevents specification corruption post-registration.

results.objective: Verify multi-tenant isolation ensures vessels belonging to other companies cannot be viewed or edited.
results.expected_result: Only owned vessels are accessible; foreign vessels cannot be accessed.
results.actual_result: Vessel ownership isolation verified in 749 ms. Other companies' vessels are hidden from directory, and backend returns 403 Forbidden upon direct API query.
results.remarks: Tenant boundaries strictly enforced at database and API levels.

results.objective: Verify Shipping Company can access Arrival Requests page and view controls.
results.expected_result: Arrival Request page loads correctly with request table and New Arrival Request control.
results.actual_result: Arrival Requests page loaded in 962 ms. Heading and 'New Arrival Request' control are active.
results.remarks: Shipping Company vessel arrival request desk loaded cleanly.

results.test_name: ARRIVAL-002 – NEW ARRIVAL REQUEST FORM LOAD
results.objective: Verify New Arrival Request form modal opens correctly with all required inputs.
results.expected_result: Form loads correctly with vessel selector, date/time fields, cargo inputs, and berth selector.
results.actual_result: New Arrival Request modal loaded in 1321 ms with vessel selector, ETA/ETD date/time pickers, berth preferences, and cargo declarations.
results.remarks: Modal provides comprehensive quayside scheduling and cargo manifest inputs.

results.objective: Verify required fields prevent submission when required fields (e.g. vessel) are unselected.
results.expected_result: Submission is blocked and validation feedback appears.
results.actual_result: Empty submission blocked in 788 ms with validation error: 'Please select a vessel.'.
results.remarks: Form blocks submission when mandatory vessel association is missing.

results.objective: Verify arrival request references a valid vessel owned by the company.
results.expected_result: Only eligible/owned vessels are selectable and our created vessel is available.
results.actual_result: Vessel dropdown contains owned fleet vessels. Successfully selected 'Selenium Test Vessel 20261007161009 (Edited)'.
results.remarks: Fleet scoping verified in arrival request modal.

results.objective: Verify arrival dates in the past are rejected with appropriate validation.
results.expected_result: Past dates are prevented/rejected.
results.actual_result: Past arrival date rejected in 2977 ms. HTML5 rangeUnderflow and arrival validation prevent past dates.
results.remarks: Chronological safety rule enforced on arrival datetime pickers.

results.objective: Verify departure must be strictly after arrival and chronology violations are rejected.
results.expected_result: Departure before or equal to arrival is rejected with validation error.
results.actual_result: Invalid chronology rejected in 1919 ms. Calculation card and validator displayed: 'Invalid Duration Window: Departure must be at least 1 hour after arrival.'.
results.remarks: Temporal window integrity checked and enforced.

results.objective: Verify departure must be at least 1 hour after arrival.
results.expected_result: Port minimum stay rule (>= 1 hour) is enforced.
results.actual_result: Minimum one-hour requirement verified in 1523 ms. Rejection displayed: 'Departure must be at least 1 hour after arrival.'.
results.remarks: PORTIDE operational standard minimum 1-hour port stay verified.

results.objective: Verify company can declare a preferred berth or choose open allocation, with disclaimer.
results.expected_result: Berth selector is accessible and indicates final allocation rests with Port Authority.
results.actual_result: Preferred berth selection verified in 3393 ms. Selected: 'None'. Final allocation notice confirmed.
results.remarks: Clear operational distinction between shipping preference and port allocation authority.

results.objective: Verify complete arrival request submission creates request in system and database.
results.expected_result: New arrival request is created with PENDING status.
results.actual_result: Arrival request submitted successfully in 7607 ms. Request (AR-0015) rendered for vessel 'Selenium Test Vessel 20261007161009 (Edited)'. Confirmed created in PostgreSQL database.
results.root_cause: Submit button inside scrollable modal container was positioned below viewport fold and intercepted. Fixed by scrolling button into center view (`scrollIntoView({block: 'center'})`), verifying visibility and enabled state, and clicking reliably.
results.remarks: Request ID: AR-0015, Vessel: 'Selenium Test Vessel 20261007161009 (Edited)', Cargo: 1500 TEU.

results.objective: Verify newly submitted arrival request enters PENDING status and is not prematurely approved.
results.expected_result: Request remains PENDING until Port Operations Officer reviews it.
results.actual_result: Request status confirmed as 'PENDING' in 5831 ms. Awaiting Port Operations review.
results.root_cause: Cascaded failure in initial run because ARRIVAL-009 failed to create an arrival request. In rerun with AR-0015 present, test passed immediately.
results.remarks: Verified strict status progression: requests remain in PENDING state upon initial submission.

results.test_name: ARRIVAL-011 – OPERATIONS OFFICER ARRIVAL REQUEST VISIBILITY
results.objective: Verify Port Operations Officer can see submitted arrival request in their review desk.
results.expected_result: Request is visible to the authorized Operations Officer.
results.actual_result: Port Operations Officer successfully accessed review desk in 5621 ms. Request for 'Selenium Test Vessel 20261007161009 (Edited)' is visible.
results.root_cause: Cascaded failure in initial run because ARRIVAL-009 failed to create an arrival request. In rerun with AR-0015 present, test passed immediately.
results.remarks: Cross-role data pipeline accurately delivers pending requests to operations officers.

results.test_name: ARRIVAL-012 – OPERATIONS OFFICER VIEW ARRIVAL DETAILS
results.objective: Verify Operations Officer can inspect full arrival request specifications.
results.expected_result: Details are displayed accurately including vessel, window, cargo, and company info.
results.actual_result: Operations details modal inspected in 6739 ms. Verified IMO, dimensions, shipping company 'Pacific' (resolved DEFECT-P4-001), timestamps, and cargo parameters.
results.root_cause: Identified during initial Phase 4 execution: frontend `PortOperationsDashboard.tsx` line 1699 attempted to read `selectedRequest.shipping_company?.shipping_company_name`, but backend serializer `VesselArrivalRequestSerializer` nests company info under `selectedRequest.vessel?.company_name`. Applied minimal fix: `{selectedRequest.shipping_company?.shipping_company_name || selectedRequest.vessel?.company_name || 'N/A'}`. Retested and resolved.
results.remarks: DEFECT-P4-001 RESOLVED: Shipping company name correctly displays as 'Pacific'. Retest PASS.

results.objective: Verify Port Operations Officer can approve a valid arrival request.
results.expected_result: Request becomes APPROVED according to PORTIDE status naming.
results.actual_result: Arrival request approved successfully in 4823 ms. Status updated to 'APPROVED' in UI and PostgreSQL database.
results.root_cause: Cascaded failure in initial run because ARRIVAL-009 failed to create an arrival request. In rerun, test selected 'none' allocation radio and approved request cleanly.
results.remarks: Port Operations Officer successfully approved arrival request AR-0015.

results.objective: Verify approved status is reflected back to the Shipping Company and persists after reload.
results.expected_result: Approved status is visible to Shipping Company and persists across page reloads.
results.actual_result: Approved status synchronized and persisted across page refresh in 6455 ms. Shipping company displays 'APPROVED' status badge.
results.root_cause: Cascaded failure in initial run because ARRIVAL-009 and ARRIVAL-013 had not executed. In rerun, status synchronization verified before and after hard reload.
results.remarks: End-to-end synchronization between operations approval and shipping company views verified.

results.objective: Verify unauthorized roles cannot access operations arrival approval routes.
results.expected_result: Unauthorized user is redirected away from operations review route.
results.actual_result: Access control enforced in 1294 ms. Client redirected to 'http://localhost:3000/shipping/dashboard', and backend API returned 403 Forbidden via IsPortOperationsOfficerOnly.
results.remarks: Zero-trust RBAC restricts operations approval capabilities to Port Operations Officers only.
